title: Resolution urging Congress to fund a savings account for every child
summary: This resolution calls on Congress to pass, and the President to sign, the American Opportunity Accounts Act (S.441/HR 1041). The bill would create a federally funded savings account for every child born in the United States, starting with a $1,000 seed deposit plus additional annual contributions based on family income. At age 18 beneficiaries could use the funds for approved purposes such as buying a first home, paying for higher education or making long-term investments.
